title: Copay Taken into a Site-Change Estimate by Financial Class — Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
The copay in the site-change estimate for an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization moved to another site (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the financial class of the patient's Patient Financial Account:

- where the class does not collect copays at check-in, the copay is nothing;
- where the class collects copays at check-in but no specialist copay above zero is recorded on the account, the copay is the office-visit copay recorded on the account;
- otherwise the copay is the specialist copay recorded on the account.

The class's collection of copays at check-in is a setting of the financial class; the specialist copay and the office-visit copay are the amounts recorded on the patient's own Patient Financial Account, the office-visit copay being the primary care office-visit copay recorded there.

## Condition table

| Class collects copays at check-in | Specialist copay recorded above zero | Copay in the site-change estimate |
|---|---|---|
| no | either | nothing (0.00) |
| yes | no (zero or none recorded) | the office-visit copay |
| yes | yes | the specialist copay |

## Questions answered (hypothetical accounts)

- *The class collects copays at check-in; the account records a specialist copay of 0.00 and an office-visit copay of 25.00.* No specialist copay above zero is recorded, so the copay is 25.00.
- *The class collects copays at check-in; the account records a specialist copay of 50.00 and an office-visit copay of 25.00.* The copay is 50.00.
- *The class does not collect copays at check-in; the account records a specialist copay of 50.00.* The copay is nothing.
